transformations: Panel a averages each predicted-group C rejection over three fitted models, using identical raw/HQR C identities. Panels b/c average monthly exact decomposition terms over those models, at separate fixed historical thresholds. No uncertainty or causal effect is implied. Unsupported-group term is identically zero for these data.
caption: Historical tail alignment and fixed-threshold drift diagnostics. (a) Thirty predicted-known groups on the same disjoint C flows; each point averages three models. Marker size denotes historical support; the dotted line is 5%. (b,c) Monthly flow-weighted known-rejection change from the historical C rate, decomposed into mixture and conditional-rate terms for raw and HQR coordinates. Total change is their sum. These fixed-threshold diagnostics differ from mean-daily FRR of rolling policies and do not identify causal mechanisms.
